title: Rectangular bar (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector set to zero. Begin by drawing a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Draw a loop consisting of four lines: the first line starts at coordinates (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0938); the third line starts at (0.75, 0.0938) and ends at (0.0, 0.0938); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.0938) and ends at (0.0, 0.0). Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using Euler angles of zero degrees and a translation vector of zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0469 units in the direction of the normal, setting the extrusion depth opposite the normal to zero. Finalize the part by creating a new solid body using the extruded sketch. The dimensions of this rectangular bar are 0.75 units in length, 0.0938 units in width, and 0.0469 units in height.

Next, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector set to (0.4727, 0.0195, 0.0469). Draw a new two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Draw a loop consisting of one circle centered at (0.0273, 0.0273) with a radius of 0.0273. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.0547. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using Euler angles of zero degrees and a translation vector of (0.4727, 0.0195, 0.0469). Extrude the sketch 0.0313 units in the direction opposite the normal, setting the extrusion depth towards the normal to zero. Finalize the part by removing material from the existing body using the extruded sketch. The dimensions of this cylindrical part with a central hole are 0.0547 units in length, 0.0547 units in width, and 0.0313 units in height.

The final shape combines the rectangular bar and the cylindrical part with a central hole. The overall dimensions are 0.75 units in length, 0.0938 units in width, and 0.0782 units in height (0.0469 + 0.0313).

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the rectangular bar
rect_bar = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0)
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.0938)
    .lineTo(0, 0.0938)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0469)
)

# Create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0273, 0.0273)
    .circle(0.0273)
    .extrude(-0.0313)
    .translate((0.4727, 0.0195, 0.0469))
)

# Combine the parts
r = rect_bar.cut(cylinder)

# Display the result

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the rectangular sketch
r = r.box(0.75, 0.0938, 0.0469, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the circular hole sketch
r = r.faces("<Z").workplane().center(0.5156, 0.0469).circle(0.0281)

# Cut the circular hole from the rectangular block
r = r.cutThruAll()

width = 0.0938
height = 0.0469

# Create the bar and cut a through hole

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(length, width, height, centered=(False, False, False))
    .faces(">Z")
    .workplane()
    .center(length * 0.667, width / 2)
    .hole(0.0500)
